sources.title: OLMoE: Open Mixture-of-Experts Language Models - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract We introduce OLMoE, 111 This paper describes the first OLMoE from 09/2024. See Appendix I for an overview of a newer version. a fully open, state-of-the-art language model leveraging sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE). OLMoE-1B-7B has 7 billion (B) parameters but uses only 1B per input token. We pretrain it on 5 trillion tokens and further adapt it to create OLMoE-1B-7B-Instruct. Our ...

sources.title: OLMoE-1B-7B-0924: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: A: The model was released in September 2024 and a newer January 2025 variant (OLMoE-1B-7B-0125-Instruct) exists with additional RLVR training. allenai continues to release updated checkpoints. For the latest improvements, check for newer variants, though the 0924 version remains a stable, well-documented baseline.
